newsitem.title: USA: Magnum Hunter gets $190 mln credit lines.
newsitem.headline: Magnum Hunter gets $190 mln credit lines.

text.p: Magnum Hunter Resources Inc said it received two new loan commitments for senior credit facilities structured as a $130 million line of credit and a $60 million one-year senior subordinated bridge line.
The commitments were received from Bankers Trust as agent, Banque Paribas and First Union National Bank of North Carolina, the company said.
The new credit facilities were conditioned on, among other things, closing an agreement with Burlington Resources Inc subsidiaries to buy certain oil and gas properties.
Magnum Hunter is an exploration and development company.
The company said the new commitments replaced prior commitments announced on April 9 from Wells Fargo Bank for a senior bank credit facility with an initial borrowing base of $145 million.
